verdict.rationale: Kitty's documented shell integration for zsh, fish and bash gives command-aware features: jumping to previous prompts, viewing the last command's output in less, and mouse cursor movement at the prompt. The evidence never mentions the specific features the story names: exit status, command duration, or notifications when long commands finish. missing for 10: evidence of exit-status tracking, command duration display, notifications on long-running command completion, and independent or hands-on corroboration of shell integration.
